page.content:
Ryu's rival and fellow student of Gouken.

How Ken Masters connects

  • Faction: World Warriors — Ken Masters is Ryu's fellow World Warrior and rival.
  • Character: Gouken — Gouken trained Ken Masters beside Ryu.
  • Item: Hadoken — Ken throws the same Hadoken his master taught Ryu.
  • Location: Metro City — Ken Masters makes his home in Metro City.

What is Ken Masters?

Ken Masters is the flame-haired American who trained beside Ryu under Gouken. He fights as a World Warrior with a flaming Shoryuken and a family life in Metro City that Ryu never settled into.

Key threads lead to World Warriors, Gouken, Hadoken and Metro City.
